# Trigger catalogue — sprezzature-figures

**Generated by `scripts/build_triggers.py`. Do not hand-edit.** A test asserts this file equals the generated output, so a phrase added here and nowhere else fails CI.

Emits data-viz / SHAP / Shapash / TimeSHAP / LIME / DoWhy figures as hand-authored SVG + audits rendered SVG and HTML figures.

## When this skill is the answer

**You are holding:** Numbers you want somebody to SEE — or a picture of a chart that is hard to read.

A phrase list cannot generalise — the ways to ask are unbounded, and a user almost never names the tool. What is bounded is the kind of thing in front of them. Match that first; the phrases below confirm a match, they do not make one.

Said without naming a tool: "show me this data", "which region is biggest", "what does this look like", "a colleague sent me this graph", « fais-moi voir », « un visuel de ça »

## When it is not

Not this one when: the numbers are attached to real PLACES (sprezzature-maps). The exhaustive trigger catalogue is in `references/triggers.md`.
